validity.researcher_notes: The project is documented as 'Western Marcellus Pipeline Project/Appalachian Connector' in EIA, run by Transcontinental Gas Pipeline (Transco/Williams). Route confirmed by geojson spanning 39.98°N,80.75°W (northern WV panhandle) to 36.91°N,79.37°W (southern Virginia/Pittsylvania area). EIA shows consistent status 'On Hold' from May 2018 through August 2026 with capacity 2000 MMcf/d and cost $500M. The discrepancy: worklist shows 'cancelled 2017' but EIA begins tracking it in May 2018 as 'On Hold'. No FERC order vacating certificate found; no Williams press release announcing formal withdrawal found. As proposed, project would move gas from Marcellus region (OH start) through WV to VA market. The 'on hold' status across 8+ years suggests indefinite suspension rather than formal cancellation. summary: P3669 Appalachian Connector is confirmed real (documented by EIA as Western Marcellus Pipeline Project/Appalachian Connector). Operator: Transco (Williams), states OH→WV→VA. Specs sourced from EIA (May 2018 release, consistent through 2026-08): 2000 MMcf/d, $500M cost. CONCERNS: (1) Status discrepancy—sheet asserts 'cancelled 2017' but EIA shows 'on hold' from May 2018 onward with no formal cancellation announcement or FERC order found; (2) Proposed 2017 but never advanced to construction (no ConstructionYear, no StartYear). As of 2026, project is 8+ years dormant; inferred cancellation applies (4y+ inactivity rule). FILLS: Capacity 2000 MMcf/d, SegmentCost $500M, states OH→VA via WV from EIA. UNRESOLVED: Length, Diameter, Pressure, Fuel Source (EIA silent); Construction/Start years (project never progressed beyond proposal/on-hold); Exact Cancelled date (unknown without FERC order).
